high_level_description: This image depicts a healthy breakfast setup on a wooden table with a woven chair in the background. The table is round and has a light brown finish. On the table, there is a white plate containing scrambled eggs, which appear to be seasoned with black pepper. Next to the plate, there is a small white dish holding a banana and some blackberries. The text overlay on the image reads, "Now for a healthy breakfast 🍞," suggesting that the meal being presented is intended to be nutritious and wholesome.
